claims.claim: Ten-seed pre-registered replication: the paired difference epsilon_C2 - epsilon_M0 is positive with paired 95% BCa CI excluding zero after BH correction on all five streams at seeds 41-50; iff true the all-five-stream significance claim is restored, otherwise the C16 four-stream narrowing stands with updated disclosure.
claims.mechanism: Gated static-base re-anchoring suppresses the topology term L_A*||Delta A_k||*||s_{k-1}|| of the event-axis error recursion.
claims.assumptions: Frozen pipeline and query identities; new seeds change only random initializations; paired within-seed design; identical evaluation window.
claims.falsifying_ablation: A2 (remove residual carry-over) closes the epsilon gap to C2, isolating the carried-residual component.
claims.split_protocol: chronological 70/15/15 with SHA-256 frozen query identities; validation-only selection; test read once
claims.primary_metric: mean per-event teacher-to-SNN state error epsilon_k
claims.minimum: paired point estimate positive on at least 4 of 5 streams at 10 seeds
claims.expected_strong: locked decision rule satisfied on all five streams (d_replication_10seed: true)
claims.failure: paired point estimate non-positive on any stream at 10 seeds, or the decision rule cannot be executed as written
claims.simple_baseline: B0 frozen ANN teacher (oracle fidelity upper bound)
claims.strong_baseline: C2 CRPI-style global carry-over conversion control

claims.calibration_evidence: v3 per-seed means and variances in results/aggregated.json; Du 2025 power argument for 8-10 paired seeds on sub-1% effects
claims.test_isolation: locked rule evaluated once on test queries; no operating-point tuning after inspection
claims.stop_return_condition: if seed 46 smoke cannot reproduce v3 numbers, return to P2 before any 10-seed claim

claims.claim: Theory package: T1 per-event coder error identity, T2 spectral-norm network bound with explicit topology term, T3 steady-state bound with rho<1 sufficient condition; signature validation V-1 violation rate at most 5% with constants estimated on validation only, V-3 topology slope positive, V-4 scaling consistent with 1/(1-rho).
claims.mechanism: Error identity plus spectral recursion over residual GCN layers isolates the operator-change term absent from 2024-26 top-venue bounds; solving the event recursion under rho<1 gives the steady-state trade.
claims.assumptions: A1-A9 retained plus bounded pre-activations, row-normalised A_k, frozen event order; T3 stated without concentration if the sub-Gaussian eta_k assumption is dropped
claims.falsifying_ablation: V-3 synthetic edge insert/delete sweep: topology-term slope must be positive and match L_A*||s|| within an order of magnitude
claims.split_protocol: chronological 70/15/15 with SHA-256 frozen query identities; validation-only selection; test read once
claims.primary_metric: V-1 violation rate of the event-axis bound
claims.minimum: theorems stated with enumerated assumptions; V-1 computed and reported regardless of level
claims.expected_strong: violation rate at most 5 percent, topology slope CI excluding zero, V-4 direction consistent with 1/(1-rho)
claims.failure: violation rate above 20 percent, or V-6 falsifies the T1 identity
claims.simple_baseline: v3 recursion with proposition (self-baseline, retained as derivation lineage)
claims.strong_baseline: ISC CVPR 2025 spectral-norm bound as structural template (literature-positioned)
claims.matched_control: A3 frozen static base (toplogy term unmitigated) as the V-3 contrast arm
claims.implementation_path: analysis scripts over v4 per-event traces extending results/bound-check instrumentation
claims.prototype_check: V-6 single-site identity check runs and confirms T1 exactly before paper drafting
claims.calibration_evidence: constants from validation histograms: L_A from measured norms, c from T-sweep intercept, eta_bar from coder residual trace
claims.test_isolation: one locked evaluation of the violation rate on the test window
claims.stop_return_condition: if V-6 falsifies T1, T1 is removed and the theory package reopens at the mechanism stage
